answer: Agents prove liveness with hardware: a reef chip signs one heartbeat per tide and may back only one agent. Haven auditors merge agents whose reef chips share an invoice, rack or network path, and the k-th agent in a merged cluster stays active only while k of its own reef chips sign every tide. Cloud enclaves share racks, so bulk rental collapses into one cluster. An honest agent runs one $40 reef, while an operator with 1,000 clones must physically own 500,500 reef chips, about $20 million, all online each tide.
